binance_ethereum_por_wallet.label: Binance 14
binance_ethereum_por_wallet.oct1_por_inclusion: CoinDesk reports this EVM wallet appears in Binance's October 1 PoR address set.
binance_ethereum_por_wallet.qualification: The 94% figure is CoinDesk's estimate if no replenishment occurred. It applies to ETH reserve coverage, not XRP. Binance's November 1 snapshot is the next expected reconciliation point.

xrp_wallet_cluster.evidence: Bithomp labels the accounts Binance and shows rDAE53 as the activation source for the inspected child accounts. Whale Alert records repeated historical large XRP rotations from rDAE53 to these Binance-labelled accounts across 2023–2026.
xrp_wallet_cluster.interpretation: This supports a connected Binance-attributed XRPL operational-wallet cluster. It does not establish whether each account was included in the October 1 proof-of-reserves wallet set or how customer liabilities were allocated to them.

xrp_por_crosswalk.required_evidence: October 1 Binance PoR downloadable all-address file or an authoritative XRP-specific reserve-address list.
xrp_por_crosswalk.retrieval_attempt: The official PoR portal exposes a Download All Address control, but static page extraction did not expose the file URL or its contents.
xrp_por_crosswalk.conclusion: The CoinDesk Binance14 finding applies to an Ethereum wallet. It cannot be transferred to the five XRPL wallets. No XRP-specific reserve shortfall can be calculated until the five source addresses are cross-referenced against the official PoR set.

incident_timeline.interpretation: The XRP drain was the earliest identified chain outflow in Range's timeline; this establishes event ordering, not a causal price impact.
